description: Traduction français → anglais : l'exercice en cours, l'urgence, les victimes, grièvement blessé, l'évacuation sanitaire, l'hélico, la voilure fixe, la voilure tournante, les informations complémentaires, jusqu'à nouvel ordre, traîner, rester dans le coin, l'ordre de mission, en permission, absent sans autorisation, le sac à vomir, réserver une place, sauf votre respect, joignable.

questions.question: l'exercice en cours (1/2 — commence par **o**)
questions.explication: *All units must report at the end of the **ongoing exercise**.* — Traductions : *ongoing exercise*, *current exercise*.

questions.question: l'exercice en cours (2/2 — commence par **c**)
questions.explication: *The **current exercise** will end at 1800.* — Traductions : *ongoing exercise*, *current exercise*.

questions.question: l'urgence
questions.explication: *Call this number only in an **emergency**.*

questions.question: les victimes (blessés et morts)
questions.explication: *The attack caused heavy **casualties**.* — *casualties* = blessés et tués ; *victims* = victimes d'un crime ou d'une catastrophe.

questions.question: grièvement blessé (1/3 — commence par **sev**)
questions.explication: *The pilot was **severely injured** in the crash.* — Traductions : *severely injured*, *seriously injured*, *badly injured*.

questions.question: grièvement blessé (2/3 — commence par **ser**)
questions.explication: *Three people were **seriously injured** on the motorway.* — Traductions : *severely injured*, *seriously injured*, *badly injured*.

questions.question: grièvement blessé (3/3 — commence par **b**)
questions.explication: *He was **badly injured** in the fall.* — Traductions : *severely injured*, *seriously injured*, *badly injured*.

questions.question: l'évacuation sanitaire
questions.explication: *The wounded soldier needed an urgent **medevac**.* — Piège : un seul *d* (pas « meddevac ») ; abréviation de *medical evacuation*.

questions.question: l'hélico (familier)
questions.explication: *We heard the **chopper** before we saw it.* — Mot familier pour *helicopter*.

questions.question: la voilure fixe
questions.explication: *The squadron flies both **fixed wings** and helicopters.*

questions.question: la voilure tournante
questions.explication: *Helicopters are known as **rotary wings**.*

questions.question: les informations complémentaires
questions.explication: *For **further information**, contact the duty officer.* — *information* est indénombrable : jamais de *s*.

questions.question: jusqu'à nouvel ordre
questions.explication: *The base is closed **until further notice**.*

questions.question: traîner, rester dans le coin
questions.explication: *Don't **hang around** after the briefing.*

questions.question: l'ordre de mission
questions.explication: *Don't forget your **travel orders** at the airport.* — Toujours au pluriel en anglais : *orders*.

questions.question: en permission
questions.explication: *Sergeant Brown is **on leave** this week.*

questions.question: absent sans autorisation
questions.explication: *The private went **AWOL** after the party.* — *AWOL* = *Absent Without Official Leave*.

questions.question: le sac à vomir (1/2 — commence par **a**)
questions.explication: *There's an **air sickness bag** in the seat pocket.* — Traductions : *air sickness bag*, *puke bag*.

questions.question: le sac à vomir (2/2 — commence par **p**)
questions.explication: *Pass me a **puke bag**, quick!* — Traductions : *air sickness bag*, *puke bag*. — *puke bag* est familier.

questions.question: réserver une place
questions.explication: *I'd like to **book a seat** on the next flight.*

questions.question: sauf votre respect
questions.explication: ***With all due respect**, sir, I disagree.*

questions.question: joignable
questions.explication: *I'm **reachable** on this number at any time.* — Piège : « joinable » n'existe pas dans ce sens. On dit aussi *contactable*.
